scheme_name: Goa State Working Journalists Welfare Scheme
other_conditions: Must be a working journalist covered under the Working Journalists and Newspaper Employees Service Conditions and Miscellaneous Conditions Act, 1955
Must have retired after at least fifteen years of service, either continuous or with intervals
Must have contributed for a minimum of 180 months under the scheme after attaining age 58 or after retirement
Must not be below 50 years of age at the time of retirement in Goa
Must register within six months of scheme implementation; a relaxation is possible for serious ailment subject to Governing Body ratification
Entitlement begins at age 58 or after completing 50 years of membership, whichever occurs earlier
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly welfare fund of ₹7,500 and a family welfare benefit of 50% of the journalist's pension to eligible retired journalists and their families.
documents_required: Self‑attested copies of all mandatory documents
